versions.changelog:
Initial release of legal-matter-intake-summarizer.

- Organizes legal intake materials into facts, disputes, missing materials, and follow-up questions—no legal conclusions provided.
- Outputs a structured summary draft for review and an actionable checklist.
- Explicitly lists missing information and items to confirm; emphasizes safety and compliance boundaries.
- Supports local resource templates and spec files for structured output.
- Designed for legal operations, intake, and case summary workflows; not for legal opinion or replacing lawyer review.
